properties.name: shinwa.service.name
properties.description: 服务名称，用于向基座注册。格式建议：shinwa-service-{domain}

properties.name: shinwa.service.base-url
properties.description: 基座网关地址，服务注册和心跳请求的目标地址

properties.name: shinwa.service.registration-enabled
properties.description: 是否启用服务注册，默认启用

properties.name: shinwa.service.registration-retry-count
properties.description: 注册失败时的最大重试次数

properties.name: shinwa.service.registration-retry-interval
properties.description: 注册失败后等待多久再重试

properties.name: shinwa.service.route-scan.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用路由扫描，默认启用

properties.name: shinwa.service.route-scan.base-packages
properties.description: 扫描的基础包，不指定则默认扫描 com.shinwa.plugin

properties.name: shinwa.service.route-scan.exclude-patterns
properties.description: 排除的路径模式，匹配这些模式的路由不会被注册

properties.name: shinwa.service.route-scan.include-actuator
properties.description: 是否包含 actuator 端点，默认不包含

properties.name: shinwa.cors.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 CORS 跨域支持，默认启用

properties.name: shinwa.audit.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用审计日志，默认启用
